requirement: Versions may now carry a single leading "v" or "V" prefix, as in "v1.2.3" or "V2"; the prefix is ignored when validating and comparing. Only one prefix character is allowed and it must be followed by a valid version (so "v", "vv1" and "1.v2" are invalid). Error messages still quote the version exactly as given, prefix included.
desc: A version is an optional single "v" or "V" prefix followed by 1 to 4 parts separated by dots, each part one or more decimal digits (leading zeros allowed: "01" means 1). The prefix is ignored when comparing. If a is not a valid version return "bad version: " followed by a (exactly as given); otherwise if b is not valid return "bad version: " followed by b. Compare the versions part by part from the left as numbers, treating missing parts as 0 (so "1.0" equals "1" and "v1" equals "1.0"). Return -1 if a is lower, 1 if a is higher, 0 if they are equal.

decls.ts: type Result<T> = { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: string };
